messages:
alex: Heads-up — planned console/docs deploy for v2.9.0 tomorrow 09:00 PT. We need final version bumps, changelog sign-off, and any SDK docs regen before cutoff (06:00 PT).

maria: OK. I have the changelog draft at https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/452 — please review the user-facing bullet about batching changes.

sam: noted. I still have one small API rename in the SDK (client.timeout -> requestTimeout). Will open a PR for the version bump now and tag for release.

chen: SDK docs regen takes ~15m on ci-docs. Command is:```bash
./scripts/regenerate-sdk-docs --targets js go python
```I'll queue it once sam's PR is merged to main.

jamie: Branch plan: freeze main at 06:00 PT, create release/v2.9 branch and cherry-pick any hotfixes. Backports should target release/v2.9 once branch exists.

alex: @sam, can you aim to have the PR merged by 04:30 PT so we can run the docs job and smoke-test?

sam: yep, I'll ping @maria for a quick review after CI passes. ETA 03:45 PT.

maria: can do a fast pass. If anything risky, call it out and we can defer to a patch in v2.9.1.

ci-bot: build #12872 finished — all checks green for the current main at 03:12 PT. (artifact: gs://ci-artifacts/docs-12872.tar.gz)

chen: Regeneration note: make sure to set the env var DOCS_BASE_URL to /docs/v2.9 so links don't collide with latest.

alex: Good catch. Also, we should include a short console banner about the change window (read-only maintenance 09:00-09:20 PT). @jamie can you add the banner content to the ops runbook?

jamie: on it. I'll update runbook and post the banner draft here by 05:00 PT.

sam: PR merged at 03:43 PT — kicked docs regen job now.

chen: docs job started at 03:50 PT. Will report back when smoke tests finish.

maria: quick changelog nudge: move the KV cache bullet to 'behavior changes' and add a migration note. small wording tweak done.

alex: thanks everyone. If smoke tests pass, we'll cut release branch at 06:00 PT and start the deploy window at 09:00 PT. If anything blocks, post here with "BLOCKER" prefix. :thumbsup:
